title: Spray Foam Storefront Frontend: Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Admin UI, and Branding

requirements.summary: Public storefront browsing: product listing, product details, and client-side cart with subtotal updates.
acceptanceCriteria: A customer can see a product listing page with product name, price, and image.
A customer can open a product detail view that shows full description and allows selecting quantity.
A customer can add/remove items from a cart and see subtotal updates client-side.

file_operations.description: Create the main app shell with routes for storefront listing, product detail, cart, and checkout, wiring navigation so pages are reachable.
Implement a cart store (context + reducer or equivalent) with add/remove/update-quantity actions and subtotal calculation persisted in-memory (optionally localStorage).
Add React Query hooks to fetch active products and single product details using the anonymous actor from useActor; include loading/error handling.
Implement the product listing UI with product cards (name, price, image) and an above-the-fold hero section; use the generated placeholder image for missing product images.
Implement product detail view with description, quantity selector, and add-to-cart action; use placeholder image when needed.
Implement cart UI (line items, quantity controls, remove, subtotal) and a clear primary CTA to proceed to checkout.
Create a shared header with logo, nav links, and cart indicator; keep it reused across storefront pages.
Create reusable product card used on listing pages; use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button) for consistent styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Checkout flow: collect customer info, show order summary, submit order, and display success/error confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkout form includes at least: full name, email or phone, delivery address, and optional notes.
Order review shows line items (product, quantity, price) and total.
Submitting an order persists it in the backend and returns an order confirmation with an order ID.
Frontend displays success and error states for order submission.

file_operations.description: Implement checkout form (name, email, phone, address fields, optional notes), validate required fields, and show an order summary (line items + total) before submission; use shadcn-ui form primitives for inputs/buttons/alerts. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a React Query mutation hook that calls the backend placeOrder capability via the actor, mapping cart items to productIds and passing delivery address/total; surface errors for UI display.
Create a confirmation view that displays the returned order ID and summary; also support an error state when order submission fails.
Wire checkout and order confirmation routes into the router and ensure navigation from cart -> checkout -> confirmation works.

requirements.summary: Admin area protected by Internet Identity: manage products (create/edit/archive) and view incoming orders.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin login uses Internet Identity; unauthenticated users cannot access admin pages.
Admin can add a new product with: name, description, price, image URL/path, and active/inactive status.
Admin can edit existing products and deactivate (archive) products without deleting historical orders.
Admin can view a list of orders with basic customer info, totals, and status (e.g., New/Processing/Fulfilled/Cancelled).
Only the configured owner principal (or an allowlist) can call admin backend methods.

file_operations.description: Create an admin-only route guard that uses useInternetIdentity for login state and checks authorization via actor.isCallerAdmin()/getCallerUserRole(); render an access denied/login prompt when unauthorized. Use patterns aligned with the selected authorization component. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an Internet Identity login/logout button using the existing useInternetIdentity hook; on logout clear cached data via React Query (per the authorization component guidance). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create an admin layout with local navigation (Products/Orders) and include LoginButton; wrap admin content with AdminGuard.

Implement product management UI: list all products, create product form, edit form, and archive/restore actions via backend calls; use shadcn-ui tables/dialogs/forms where available. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement orders list UI showing customer info, totals, and status; allow updating status (e.g., pending/processing/shipped/delivered/cancelled) via backend call; show loading/error states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add React Query hooks for admin product operations (list all, create, update, archive, restore) using the actor and invalidating relevant queries on success.
Add React Query hooks for admin orders (list, update status) using the actor with proper cache invalidation and error handling.
Register admin routes (e.g., /admin/products and /admin/orders) and ensure they are only accessible via AdminGuard; ensure public storefront routes remain accessible without login.
Add an Admin link that is visible but routes to guarded admin pages (or only visible when authenticated), without blocking public storefront access.

requirements.summary: Cohesive industrial storefront theme: neutral high-contrast palette (no blue/purple), strong typography, consistent responsive spacing and CTA hierarchy.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across product listing, product detail, cart, checkout, and admin screens.
Primary and secondary buttons have clearly differentiated styles and consistent hover/focus states.
Layout is responsive (mobile and desktop) with readable typography and accessible contrast.

file_operations.description: Define global theme tokens/CSS variables for a neutral industrial palette (charcoal/gray + warm accent), typography, and consistent focus/hover states; ensure shadcn-ui variables align with the theme.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions as needed to support the neutral + warm accent palette and consistent container/typography utilities (avoid blue/purple defaults).
Create a shared layout (header + content container + footer spacing) used by both public and admin pages to enforce consistent spacing and responsive structure.
Wrap routes with the shared Layout so storefront and admin screens share consistent typography, spacing, and CTA styling conventions.

requirements.summary: Add generated static brand assets (logo, hero/banner, product placeholder) and use them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
Storefront home/listing page displays the hero/banner image.

file_operations.description: Add the generated logo asset at the exact required path/filename for direct static use in the frontend.
Add the generated hero/banner asset at the exact required path/filename for direct static use in the frontend.
Add the generated product placeholder asset at the exact required path/filename for direct static use in the frontend.
Render the logo image from frontend/public/assets/generated/spray-foam-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header/nav (with appropriate alt text and sizing).
Display the hero/banner image from frontend/public/assets/generated/spray-foam-hero.dim_1600x600.png in the top section of the storefront listing page.
Use frontend/public/assets/generated/spray-foam-product-placeholder.dim_800x800.png as the fallback when a product image is missing or fails to load.
